purpose: Review item #3: per-term training-gradient norms and pairwise angles on the shared R2P parameters, plus round1-vs-round2 task gradients. Frozen checkpoint; no optimizer.step; read-only.
step_selection_rationale: Chosen before inspecting any gradient value: spread over the frozen schedule (early/mid/late), step 200 through 2800; the very first and very last steps are avoided. Not selected by observed result.

gradient_semantics.weighted: unit * the weight the term carries in the objective
gradient_semantics.clip_convention: training clips the SUMMED gradient over model.parameters() to global norm grad_clip=1.0 after backward; a uniform rescale that cannot change any pairwise angle. NOT applied here.
gradient_semantics.ste_note: quantization preprocessing in the diffusion stream uses a straight-through estimator, so all vectors are the implementation's SURROGATE gradients

objective: total = round_weights[0]*L(T1) + round_weights[1]*L(T2) + lambda*alignment  with round_weights=[0.5, 1.0]

decompositions.real_path: single forward; round 2 consumes the graph-attached P1, exactly as training builds it; round-2 gradients include the through-P1 path. The SUM of its parts reproduces training's actual update direction.
decompositions.isolated: round 2 consumes a DETACHED P1, so its gradient on the shared parameters is attributable to round 2 alone. This is the decomposition used to ask whether round 2 conflicts with round 1.

clip_bookkeeping.note: training clips the summed gradient over ALL model.parameters() (shared R2P + projections + feedback adapter) jointly to global norm 1.0; this number covers only the shared R2P block, so it is a LOWER BOUND
